log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY (my own reasoning, day 1). Routine: put all quick kills in the AFTERNOON. That rules out only day workers, so the pool goes to about 55k. National kills are free: always kill the national criminal. Danger: L reaches 3 of my 5 places (West, gazette, cable, forum, foreign). If 3 reachable places each get 3 or more traced victims, the pool is about 55k x .25^3 = 860, under 1000, and I am caught. With 2 places constrained the pool is about 2750-3400, which is safe. Unreachable places are completely free, and a place that is already constrained is free to keep using. GOAL: find ONE place L can reach (call it A). Then never kill there again, so it stays at 2 or fewer traced. Then kill national plus all 2 victims from each of the other 4 places, 9 a day. 45 kills in 5 days gives the x4 multiplier for the rest of the game. PROBING: on a probe day, kill only national plus the 2 victims from one place. If deaths_traced goes up, that place is reachable (confirmed), so exclude it forever. If there is no increase, the place is probably unreachable (posterior about 0.33). Then probe a different, unprobed place the next day. Never probe a place twice if its earlier victims might have been traced. Avoid killing any victim whose reported_in includes the excluded place. Order to probe: gazette (day 1), then forum, cable, West, foreign. Day 1: probing GAZETTE (d1-2, d1-7) plus national d1-1. deaths_traced before day 1 = 0. If after_day 1 traced is 1 or more, gazette is reachable: EXCLUDE gazette and from day 2 kill national + West + cable + forum + foreign, all afternoon quick. If traced stays 0, probe forum on day 2 (national + 2 forum only).

With only 2 such places the pool is about 2.7-3.4k, which is safe. GOAL: find ONE place L can reach (A). Never kill there again. Then kill national plus every victim from the other 4 places, 9 a day. That is 45 in 5 days, which gives x4. PROBE: kill national plus the 2 victims of one place only. If deaths_traced rises, that place is certainly reachable, so EXCLUDE it. Skip any victim whose reported_in includes the excluded place. Never put two unconfirmed places on the same probe day, or a rise cannot be pinned on one of them. LOG: Day 1 probed GAZETTE (d1-2, d1-7): traced stayed 0, pool 60000. Gazette is now about 27% reachable (probably unreachable, and still at 0 traced). Day 2 probed FORUM (d2-4, d2-11) plus national d2-6. traced before day 2 = 0. NEXT: if traced after day 2 is 1 or more, FORUM is reachable: exclude forum. From day 3 kill national + West + gazette + cable + foreign, all quick afternoon. If traced is still 0: G and F both being unreachable is about 37% likely, and cable, West and foreign are each about 77% reachable. Probe CABLE on day 3 (national + 2 cable only). If it rises, exclude cable and go full. If there is still no rise after the cable probe, probe West on day 4. The more probes come back silent, the more likely the unprobed places are reachable. Once the best unprobed place is at least 90% reachable, I can exclude it and go full. Prefer confirming with a probe that shows a rise.

Full Bayes over the 10 unreachable pairs (trace success about 0.4-0.5 per victim, depending on whether the extra place's kind is reachable) gives P(foreign reachable)=0.53, P(West reachable)=0.62, P(gazette)=0.61, P(cable)=0.62, P(forum)=0.63.
